# graylog_stream (Data Source)

Retrieves a single Graylog stream by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "graylog_stream" "example" {
  id = "existing-stream-id"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The stream ID.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String)
- `disabled` (Boolean)
- `index_set_id` (String)
- `is_default` (Boolean)
- `matching_type` (String)
- `remove_matches_from_default_stream` (Boolean)
- `title` (String)
